Dengue_Dhaka_Base.description: Profile for curriculum stages 1 and 2. Biology and economics are identical to Dengue_Dhaka_Advanced.

Balanced_Medium_Budget._note: alias of DNCC_Seasonal_Budget; the tutorial stages default to this name

Dengue_Dhaka_Advanced.description: Profile for curriculum stage 3 and every evaluation.

DNCC_Seasonal_Budget._note: 54 wards x 8,903,134 = 480,769,236 BDT/season. Pop 5,919,169, i.e. 81.2 BDT/person.

DNCC10_Seasonal_Budget._note: 10 wards x 9,611,577 = 96,115,770 BDT/season. Pop 1,183,365, per-capita matched to DNCC at 81.2 BDT/person.

_calibration._provenance_classes: M measured, D derived, C calibrated, A adopted from the literature, P posited.
_calibration.dynamics_substeps: 7 daily sub-steps per weekly decision. A numerical setting: the generation interval is about 16 days (Liu et al. 2020), too short for weekly steps.
_calibration.recovery_rate: 1.4 per week, a 5-day infectious period after symptom onset. Class A. Duong et al. 2015; Nguyet et al. 2013.
_calibration.extrinsic_incubation_rate: 0.933 per week, a 7.5-day extrinsic incubation period. Class A. Slightly shorter than the 7.7 to 9.9 days the fitted means of Chan and Johansson 2012 give at 28 to 29 C.
_calibration.mosquito_mortality_rate: 0.816 per week, from daily survival 0.89 (mu = -7 ln 0.89); mean lifespan 8.6 days. Class A. Garcia et al. 2016; Maciel-de-Freitas et al. 2007; Brady et al. 2013.
_calibration.carrying_capacity_multiplier: 5.5. Class C. Fitted with src/calibrate_k.py so the untreated growth rate, 0.173 per week, lies in the DGHS take-off band of 0.154 to 0.185; every value from 4.5 to 6.0 fits.
_calibration.mosquito_birth_rate: 1.75 per week. Class C, set with K: the take-off data fix K(1 - mu/b), not either alone.
_calibration.biting_rate_per_week: 3.25 per week, 0.46 bites per mosquito per day. Class A. Inside the field estimates of 0.35 to 0.76 reviewed by Zahid et al. 2023.
_calibration.transmission_probabilities: Human to mosquito 0.40, class A, inferred from direct feeding on infected people (Duong et al. 2015; Nguyet et al. 2013). Mosquito to human 0.475, class P.
_calibration.seasonality: Sinusoidal, peak week 28, baseline 0.2, amplitude 0.75. Class P.
_calibration.spatial_spread: Human coupling 0.15, vector coupling 0.02: each ward mixes (1 - rho) of its own pressure with rho of its neighbours' mean. Class P.
_calibration.total_episode_budget_per_site: Season budget divided by wards. DNCC FY2025-26 insecticide (Tk 80 cr) and outsourced operations (Tk 45 cr) lines, times 20/52. Class M for the lines, D for the season budget.
_calibration.delta_penalty_human_I: 10,000 BDT per infection = 0.25 symptomatic share (Bhatt et al. 2013) x 39,893 BDT societal cost per episode (Sarker et al. 2023). Class D.
_calibration.case_management_cost: 6,076 BDT, public-hospital provider cost per patient (Sarker et al. 2023), charged per infected person per week. Class M.
_calibration.vector_control_cost: 9 BDT per person per weekly round: Tk 80 cr / 5,919,169 residents / 52 weeks = 2.6, divided by an assumed 30% of residents reached per round. Class P.
_calibration.larviciding_cost: 11 BDT per person per week: US$0.20 per person covered per campaign (Suaya et al. 2007, 2005 prices), 26 BDT in 2023, over the 2.4-week median field residual (Garelli et al. 2011). Class P.
_calibration.survey_cost: 5 BDT per person per week. Class P; no Bangladeshi source. The paper reports results across this price.
_calibration.efficacies: Adulticide 0.62 at reference, swept 0.10 to 0.90; larviciding 0.65, class A; surveillance detection 0.72 and case management 0.50, class P.
_calibration.alpha_benefit: Enters one observation feature only; not used in the reward, the dynamics or the costs.
_calibration.lambda_sigma: 0.8, passed on the command line; the top 20% of wards then carry 49.2% of risk on 54 wards. Class P.
_calibration.population: BBS Population and Housing Census 2022: 5,919,169 on 54 wards, 1,183,365 on 10. Class M.
